title: Safe system assembly
requirement: Install sample CPU, cooler, DDR5 and storage, with correct retention and de-energized service checks.

title: Standby and power sequencing
requirement: Verify standby, simulated power-good, CPU and memory rails against approved reference data.

title: POST and memory training
requirement: Diagnose simulated CPU/DRAM/VGA/BOOT stages and achieve verified fresh POST.

title: PCIe and NVMe qualification
requirement: Enumerate graphics and four M.2 sockets; explain CPU-specific lane sharing.

title: Three physical repair cases
requirement: Diagnose the simulated VRM, memory, and storage faults by trusted measurement and repeat tests.

title: Protected return to service
requirement: Verify shutdown/restart, thermal response, protection and stable repeated boot. No fictional safety jumper on commercial motherboard.
